name: quantinuum_helios
source: Ransford et al., 'Helios: A 98-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer', arXiv:2511.05465 (Nov 2025): 98 137Ba+ qubits, all-to-all; native RZZ(theta) gate, single-qubit U1Q with software Z; zone-averaged infidelities 2.5(1)e-5 (1Q, Clifford RB) and 7.9(2)e-4 (2Q RB), both including leakage; SPAM: 8(1)e-4 preparing |0>, 1.6(5)e-4 preparing |1>; linear memory error rate 5(1)e-4 per depth-1 transport operation. Assumptions: the memory error is applied per qubit per two-qubit gate layer; the quadratic memory term (7e-5) is not modelled. Not modelled: leakage as a separate state, measurement crosstalk.
